name: tesla-wrap-studio
description: Design and preview custom wraps for your Tesla Model 3 (2024+ Premium).

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm --prefix web run build && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix server install
